Bench: Sanjay Dwivedi

 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
 Mp No. 1252 of 2024
 (Ashutosh Chaturvedi Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh 
 Dated : 31-05-2024
 Shri B.N. Pandey - Advocate for the petitioner.

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Girish Kekre - Government Advocate for the responde

In pursuance of order dated 29.05.2024, respondent No.2, Sub Divisional Officer, Tahsil
Mangawan/Land Acquisition Officer, Unit Nos.5 and 6 Bansagar Project is present in the Court
along with relevant record.

Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties, it appears that to resolve the dispute, record of execution case shall be required to ascertain as to whether the reference against the award passed by the Land Acquisition Officer was made by the petitioner or by the Land Acquisition Officer itself because the orders passed by the Reference Court create confusion wherein the Land Acquisition Officer was treated to be applicant and claimant was treated to be non-applicant.

That apart, in the reply filed by the respondents, they have annexed a copy of reference made by the applicant under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 whereas the order passed by the Court reveals that the reference was made under the provisions of old act i.e. Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
